notes: Current Junior Disciples who meet field qualification and issue requirements are combat-capable and available for legal deployment. Trainees are not field-qualified and may fight only in immediate local self-defense until promoted to Junior Disciple.
Sword Manor acceptance requires total allegiance, information exclusivity, and martial exclusivity for the term of enrollment.

Fifty Sword Manor physicians, healers, orderlies and evacuation staff are civilian medical/camp-support population under Lin Mei's professional medical authority when assigned. They do not belong to Sword Manor military manpower, do not form units, do not take command slots, and are exposed to casualties only through actual camp, treatment-site or evacuation-chain danger.
